description: Verify that the runbook explicitly defines a per-host grant mechanism, ensuring that access is restricted to specific hostnames rather than global or wildcard domains.
Confirm that the runbook includes a defined expiry mechanism for the access grant, such as a timestamp or duration limit.
Ensure the runbook specifies that the browser task is read-only, explicitly prohibiting write operations or state modifications.
Validate that the runbook contains a section or step detailing the planning phase for the browser task, including prerequisites or setup instructions.
